headlines.splitStep_uniform: KemBound -> for every t p created query x: ((handlerWith setup codec route (idealSplit setup codec route checks t p created) query).run x).IsTotalQueryBound (splitWeight caps (commandKind query)); splitWeight = [1, 64 + keygenCost, 32, 140 + encapsCost, 108 + 64 + 64, 69 * max 64 decapsCost + 64, 64, 64, 64, 64, 64, 64]
headlines.guessStep_uniform / guessStep_base: every step of guessReg: IsMlKemUniformQuery <= splitWeight caps (commandKind query) (KemBound); IsMlKemBaseQuery 0
headlines.flat_uniform / game_uniform: one complete-interface query: <= guessWeight caps bounds (queryClass query); whole guesser game against a budget-respecting adversary: <= sum_kind guessWeight kind * budget.cap kind
headlines.guessWeight_eq: guessWeight caps bounds = splitWeight on the twelve native classes, test 1 + 64 + 64, fresh bounds.max + 64 + 64
headlines.guessBill / guessBill_eq: not tight: the create weight (64 + keygenCost) includes a key generation beyond the pool, which the guesser (pool of qCreate + 1 key pairs, PqxdhDeploymentIdealParams.pool_length; createPool draws only at a missing pool index) never reaches under the budget, so guessBill over-charges by qCreate * keygenCost; guessBill caps qInit B bounds = (B.create + 1) * keygenCost + (qInit + 32) + sum_kind B.cap kind * guessWeight kind = (qCreate + 1)keygenCost + (qInit + 32) + qCoin + (64 + keygenCost)qCreate + 32 qBundle + (140 + encapsCost)qAccept + 236 qBuild + (69 max(64, decapsCost) + 64)qFinish + 64(qHmac + qHash + qServerSend + qServerRaw + qBeaconSend + qBeaconRaw) + 129 qTest + (bounds.max + 128)qFresh
headlines.anomalyGuesser_uniform / anomalyGuesser_: anomalyGuesser (Target count) ...: IsMlKemUniformQuery <= (count + 1) keygenCost + (qInit + 32) + sum_kind budget.cap kind * guessWeight kind (KemBound, initBound, Respects); IsMlKemBaseQuery 0
headlines.ptc_bills: (ptc setup.kem (anomalyGuesser setup codec route checks (Target.ofCE budget g) ensureInit 0 runtime bounds mode adversary)).MakesAtMostQueries (guessBill caps qInit budget bounds) 0 (budget.finish + 1) 0 0 0 (KemBound, initBound, budget.Respects)

headlines.billed forms (PqxdhDeploymentHeadlineGat: ce_app(_target)_billed, ce_or_s2b(_target)_billed, ce_uks_sender(_target)_billed, ce_lor(_target)_billed: frozen bound and TargetBills; ce_or_s2b_sym_billed, ce_uks_sym_billed, ce_app_beacon_sym_billed: and TargetBills and A1Bills; ce_app_sym_billed: TargetBills, A2Bills, A1Bills; symbolic_lor_bound_billed: TargetBills, A2Bills, A1Bills, InjBills; ce_or_injective_s2b(_full)_billed: TargetBills, A1Bills, InjBills; anomaly_beta_billed: anomaly_beta and ptc_bills. headlines.game_ghost: PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game ... .run runtime = forget <$> (gameG ...).run runtime (the ghost-instrumented experiment: handlerG logs the created owners' KEM keys and each raw accept attempt's encapsulation (verified PQ key, ciphertext array) at the encapsulate callback)
headlines.acceptEnc_expect / create_expect / handl: the logged encapsulation is a fresh draw encC setup key after the key is fixed; the create logs one keyGen setup draw; a ghost potential whose expectation does not increase over these draws (and over none) does not increase over any query or over the run
headlines.triple_le: for every owner index k and raw accept attempts i < j: Pr[TripleColl k i j] in gameG <= pairCollision setup (potential phi: pairCollision with nothing drawn, CP(pk_k), KG(pk) D_pk(c), [pk = pk_k] D_pk_k(c), [repeat] KG(pk), collision indicator; pairHit_mean: E_keygen[CP] = pairCollision)
headlines.Tracks / tracks_step / tracks_game: run invariant of gameG (Phase1ReadBack, Phase2ReadBack): encs indexed by sessions = accept count; acceptOf -> verified key of the logged encapsulation; pending token -> logged ciphertext; buildOf read back -> logged ciphertext; keys = owners' KEM keys; bundleOf publishedPq -> logged key
headlines.ctColl_triple: on every outcome of gameG of a budget-respecting adversary: happens (ctCollEvent crypto codec) (forget outcome) -> exists k < qCreate, j < qAccept, i < j, TripleColl k i j outcome
headlines.ct_collision_game: ctCollTerm setup codec checks route ensureInit bounds mode adversary runtime <= ((budget.create * budget.accept.choose 2 : Nat) : ENNReal) * pairCollision setup (Phase1ReadBack, Phase2ReadBack, budget.Respects)
headlines.ct_coll_le / ctCollEps: ctCollTerm ... <= ctCollEps setup budget = (qCreate * C(qAccept, 2)) * (ofReal Adv^IND-CCA(pairAdversary) + 2 * ofReal correctnessError + 2^-256) (adds FunctionalDecapsulation, through pair_cp_le); ct_coll_billed adds pair_bills (KemBound); ctCollEps_le_design: at most the design form with (qCreate + 1)
headlines.closed forms (PqxdhDeploymentHeadlineCtC: ce_or_s2b_sym_closed, ce_uks_sym_closed, symbolic_lor_closed (+ FunctionalDecapsulation), symbolic_lor_bound_closed, ce_or_injective_s2b_closed, ce_or_injective_s2b_full_closed: frozen bound with ctCollTerm replaced by ctCollEps setup budget, frozen premises; ce_or_s2b_sym_closed_billed, ce_uks_sym_closed_billed, symbolic_lor_bound_closed_billed, ce_or_injective_s2b_closed_billed, ce_or_injective_s2b_full_closed_billed: closed bound, the bills of the Gated billed form, and PairBills setup caps
headlines.handleAd / AdKept: handleAd control (.peer keyId) = associatedBytes server.identity peer.identity (serverOwner); handleAd control (.owner c) = absBytes shell.associatedData (beaconOwner, established); AdKept (every present AD kept): handler_adKept, schedule_adKept, interpreted_adKept, native_adKept, native_program_adKept, full_adKept
headlines.SealAd / ctxRun_sealAd: SealAd control secret := forall label entry in (secret.keys label).1.successfulSeals, exists handle, OwnsLabel control label handle and handleAd control handle = some entry.input.context.ad.bytes; holds on every supported outcome of every ideal CTX world (modes not real, any replace, env, adversary)
headlines.AcceptedAd / ctxRun_entryAd: AcceptedAd = frozen Accepted plus handleAd control handle = some entry.input.context.ad.bytes; ctxRun_entryAd: every transcript entry of every supported outcome satisfies EntryAd (each successful raw receive has its receiving handle and AcceptedAd) at the final control and private state; no FrameReadBack premise
headlines.Production / AgreeFailure: Production control secret h frame ad m := exists label entry, OwnsLabel control label h, entry in dict(label), Matches frame entry, (some h, frame) in produced, entry AD bytes = ad, entry plaintext = m; AgreeFailure: exists accepted raw receive (transcript, receivingHandle, hidden slot, frameRead) with no other ad, Counterpart slot h other, Production other frame ad decrypted.plaintext, handleAd h = some ad, handleAd other = some ad
headlines.agreement_statement: AgreementStatement setup codec route serverKid bounds n := forall E X env mode adversary, D[agreeEvent codec route <$> idealAuth setup codec route env serverKid bounds mode adversary] {true} = 0; proved for every argument with no premise (ctxRun_agree_zero for every ideal mode assignment, idealRecords_agree_zero)
headlines.ctxRun_agreement / ctxRun_peer_agreement: pointwise positive AG on every supported outcome; Server peer receive: established owner holding the slot produced the frame with the received plaintext and AD associatedBytes(server.identity, peer.identity), and its shell AD is that AD; owner receive: symmetric with the Server peer; owner_pin: shell AD = associatedBytes server peer and shell.associatedData = associatedArray pin beacon -> pin = server and beacon = peer
headlines.associatedBytes_inj: associatedBytes server peer = associatedBytes server2 peer2 -> server = server2 and peer = peer2 (extracted build_associated_data, Rust beaconcrypt-core/src/pqxdh.rs:928-947; via associatedBytes_exact and Pqxdh.assocData_inj)

one finish weight (the real finish's 69 * max 64 decapsCost, which dominates the challenge finish by challenge_le) plus the Beacon install seed
a test query is charged at both send classes (wrapCost), so u(test) = 129
CE-A1 bills through a1_bills (resource premises only) rather than ce_a1_billed (security premises)

step 2: route via a ghost-instrumented copy of the experiment and an expected-potential (supermartingale) argument per triple instead of a game decomposition at two accept ordinals; the design's hit set is replaced by the union over triples, and an owner created after the earlier accept is covered by the KG factor, so CP is averaged over key generation (pairCollision)

step 2: closed forms are new theorems generated from the frozen statements (ce12/p2b/gen/closed.py); symbolic_lor_closed adds FunctionalDecapsulation; the five step-1 billed forms are closed too, with PairBills

premises: initBound (total query bound qInit of the runtime initializer)
Phase1ReadBack and Phase2ReadBack (step 2: ct_collision_game and the run invariant)
step 3: none (agreement_statement and every AG lemma take no premise)
FunctionalDecapsulation setup.kem (step 2: ct_coll_le, through pair_cp_le; symbolic_lor_closed adds it)
the premises of each frozen headline for its billed and closed forms

not_claimed: no closed epsilon_ct: ctGapTerm stays an explicit probability in the real experiment (F-ct2, D-ct deferred); ctCollTerm is closed by ct_coll_le in the closed forms, the frozen theorems still carry it
no KEM min-entropy or collision property: CP is bounded only through pair_cp_le (Adv^IND-CCA(pairAdversary) + 2 delta_corr + 2^-256); the union bound over qCreate * C(qAccept, 2) triples is not tight

the bills are query caps in the existing cost model, not running-time bounds; deterministic local work is not counted; they are worst-case caps and need not be tight (test at both send classes; every finish at the real finish's cap; guessBill over-charges by qCreate * keygenCost)

step 3: no statement in the common deployment experiment: AG is proved in idealAuth (every ideal CTX world) and not lifted through the chain, so the b2s Server-pin and mode-O plaintext rows of design-v2 section 7.6 stay symbolic-only
step 3: AG covers handles holding hidden slots and raw receives only; agreement is with a production (published or not)
open_points: owner flag of P2 open point 1 (a): the ctGapTerm half stands (F-ct2); the ctCollTerm half and the gate of the headlines with ctCollTerm on ct_collision_game are closed by ct_coll_le and the closed forms; the beta_g gate on guessBill is closed (step 1)

AG lift, R1 (b2s Server pin, 1-2 actual days): CE event (accepted b2s raw receive on a peer designating g whose counterpart owner g.2 was created with a pin different from the Server identity carried by session g.1's build response, Phase2ReadBack); chain_server, auth_le, containment in AgreeFailure on the support of idealAuth at envGD from ctxRun_peer_agreement and the IdealSlots restriction plus two ideal-environment invariants (installed shell AD = associatedArray(created pin, identity); source control Server identity = identity field of every build response); bound kemLoss + slotLoss + authLoss_g(dec_g and ISs_g)

AG lift, R2 (mode-O plaintext, b2s and s2b, 1.5-3 actual days): ledger-level seal-source invariant (every dictionary seal at a label owned by a handle comes from a transcript command of that handle with its plaintext) and one seal per frame and handle (label position = sequence - 1, at most one successful seal per label); containment in AgreeFailure or the unpublished event (publicationTerm); b2s through chain_server, s2b through chain_beta
